items.asks: How data were assigned to partitions
items.evidence: every two-sample test scored out of fold over at most five folds grouped by person and stratified by label, so a person is wholly on one side of each split; the split-half nulls split each group of at least 40 persons in two by person; every draw from seed 0 (summary.txt record; tools/domain_gap.py at commit 6e908e6, README sections 1 and 4)

items.asks: Level at which partitions are disjoint
items.evidence: by person: every test's folds are grouped by person, so no person is on both sides of a split, and two render groups on one CT folder are read as a paired sample whose two views of a CT fall in one fold (tools/domain_gap.py at commit 6e908e6); in the 7 groups whose persons are their files (summary.txt, persons by file: fluorogen, aasce, nhanes2, csxa, kub_stonex, ieee_lateral, aariz) only files are held apart
needs the owner's answer under "intended_sample_size" in data/reporting/studies/drr-domain-gap.json

no network is trained; the instruments are the feature spaces summary.txt names, flexray dim 1024 over 10127 rows; imagenet dim 512 over 10127 rows: FleXray's flagship member flux0375 at the input of the last instance norm of its deepest encoder block, torchvision's ResNet-18 with ImageNet weights and handcrafted physics measures; and on each two two-sample classifiers, logistic regression (scaler, PCA to 64, C 1) and 15 nearest neighbours (tools/domain_gap.py at commit 6e908e6, README sections 3 and 4)

the pins flexray[train] 1.0.2 nanodrr 0.1.5 scikit-learn 1.9.1 umap-learn 0.5.12 numpy 2.4.6 over the train-gpu torch over train-gpu's locked pixi environment (pixi.lock) at commit 6e908e6; the MMD computed on torch-cuda (summary.txt record)

no parameter is trained from an initial state: FleXray's encoder and the ResNet-18 are read with their published weights, unchanged, and the two-sample classifiers are fit afresh in each fold; every draw is seeded from 0 (summary.txt record; tools/domain_gap.py at commit 6e908e6)

no network is trained; the one fitting is each two-sample test's classifiers, logistic regression and 15 nearest neighbours, each with its scaler and PCA fit inside the fold, every row scored by a fit that held none of its person's rows (tools/domain_gap.py at commit 6e908e6 and tools/domain_gap_stats.py, README section 4)
